changes.v5_assertion: Every model expected literal was an exact member of caller.expect_text, every forbidden literal of caller.forbid_text.
changes.v6_change: Withdrawn. Bounded native intermediate literals are untrusted predictions and need not belong to caller final pools.
changes.reason: A caller final state may not describe distinct intermediate operations. The high-level model must be able to propose an observable intermediate contract.
replacement_verification: Raw strict strings/lists/required fields and <=200/<=8 limits.

Known successful input plus trusted new scoped post observation must verify the actual literal contract; absence remains failed.
Original caller final remains independently verified and cannot be rewritten by native fields.

changes.v5_assertion: An empty caller side forced the corresponding model checklist maxItems=0.

changes.reason: Independent caller final polarity does not enumerate every valid intermediate visible/absent condition.
replacement_verification: SDK request body contains the same bounded free-string schema as prompt text.

changes.v5_assertion: Fewer than two distinct signed caller predicates, including case aliases, returned clarification before observation/HTTP.
changes.v6_change: Withdrawn. A single caller final may coexist with at least two meaningful native predicted intermediate objectives.

replacement_verification: At least two native meaningful initial objectives, distinct identities/check conjunctions, primitive/caller-copy rejection.
Every actual goal before predicate remains false and actual post evidence is mandatory.

changes.v5_assertion: A caller final literal longer than 200 returned clarification before observation/HTTP.

changes.reason: The goal output schema no longer has to enumerate the caller final value.
replacement_verification: No truncation of caller context, saved request, compiled independent final or runtime final verification.

changes.v5_assertion: Whitespace/case substitutions failed exact caller membership before Pydantic.
changes.v6_change: Outer whitespace remains rejected explicitly; arbitrary letter case is preserved byte-for-byte as a prediction rather than restricted by pool membership.
changes.reason: Raw-to-compiled identity is required independently of where a predicted status came from. Existing verifier remains case-insensitive substring matching.
replacement_verification: Native raw dict/list/type/count/length/nonblank and raw==raw.strip checks occur before Pydantic.
No silent instruction/check stripping; exact native/validated/compiled check strings are audited.

replacement_verification: Same _validate substring conflict guard and explicit generic prompt sentence.

changes.v5_assertion: Declared complete unresolved markers and contradictory caller final positive/negative literals stop before observation/HTTP.

changes.reason: These independent conservative checks do not depend on intermediate prediction membership.
replacement_verification: Exact reserved forms remain 0observe/0HTTP/0input; bare unknown/TBD not overclaimed as ambiguity detection.

changes.v5_assertion: Each whole goal predicate must be unsatisfied before input; no claim of arbitrary control-role/negation detection.
changes.v6_change: Retained. Current visible caption alone cannot receive credit; a genuinely new control may witness a stage. No generic caption ban or new matcher was added.

replacement_verification: Before-false + known input + trusted fresh post + independent events remain necessary.
